nom: Philosophy Microdelivery Resurfacing Solution with 4% AHA's, Cica and Vitamin C

avis.texte: Everytime I try to use this, I get a major breakout the next day and my skin feels clammy and has like an odd to it. Very weird and sucks I. And use the product ever . Not recommended for sensitive skin
I am ready to order my 3rd bottle!! I have noticed such an improvement on my face and chest. My skin is so much softer and smoother, less dry feeling.
Love this after washing my face with purity leaves a clean refreshing feeling on my face.
I had tiny little white bumps on my face (not pimples). Using this product consistently eliminated them and the skin is smoother. An added bonus, my skin is softer with more elasticity.
I've only been using a week and I see the difference already. My skin looks more even and refreshed. Way to go Philosophy.

avis.titre: Not as effective as the chemical peel kit
avis.texte: I really don't notice a difference in exfoliation. More of a toner.
So far, I believe my skin is looking brighter and smoother since using this several nights per week. It goes on without any irritation.
I find that this product really helps to shrink the large pores on my nose.
Have not tried this before but I am liking the way my skin feels after applying. My favorite Purity Mask was discontinued so trying to find a replacement.
I received a sample of this with one of my orders and new right away I wanted to order it! I'm really liking it!
I love this product. It was in my ipsy bag. I made a skin care routine with it and I am happy with the product. I like the way it works and feels on my face.
Resurfacing solution made my skin less red. I am currently using second bottle and will definitely reorder again. Does not make my skin sticky or oily.

I have been using this for a very short time. Thus far it seems to be a good item to use. The system to use it is odd. I press it down onto a cotton pas but it does not dispense easily. It will take time to really get the effect promised.
new micro delivery rejuvenation formula, it is about giving and receiving, it is soft and for daily use, it calms, replenishes and hydrates.

I was expecting to feel a slight ting or burn as I read several reviews of individuals experiencing that however I did not have any of those issues. For me this was gentle on my skin and I really enjoyed using it, applying after washing my face made my skin feel fresh and clean. After more than a week of use I can see the difference in my skin tone.

avis.titre: Literally changed my skin for the best!!
avis.texte: I was a longtime believer that some products are just good advertising…. But not this product. This product has worked so well for me! I've tried so many products on the shelf and from the dermatologist and still struggled with acne, but then after i added this resurfacing solution to my routine, i noticed my acne started clearing and my skin looked softer and smoother. This is one of the only products that have worked for me! Please, give it a chance! I hope it works for you too!
My skin absolutely loves this! Feels so soft after using! Your products are amazing!
I love the microdelivery solution. My face feels so soft, smooth and looks toned after using it. It's very cooling. I'm going to love it more in the summer!

I love this product. I really see a difference in the texture and brightness on my face. But I find it's even better on the back of my hands, which were never feeling moisturized by end of winter. I use it 5 nights a week on my hands even if not using that night on my face. They are now smooth and feel soft. Great product if you don't like the grit of physical exfoliation.

This has definitely helped with uneven skin tone like sunspots but hasnt helped with redness from acne scarring which is what i was hoping. It has helped with breakouts. Been using it about a month now. I think it's a good product and does serve a purpose. I'm not sure it is does what i needed it for. I will continue to use it and see if it gets better

avis.titre: Tried for a month, actually gave me acne
avis.texte: Tried this product for a month and I've never had more acne then ever! I stopped using it and my acne improved. Tried it again and another huge flare. So I just stopped. Super disappointed as I had high hopes and the product is expensive! Also, the liquid doesn't come out of the top and sprays to the side which is a huge waste. I use the microdelivery exfoliant face wash which is awesome so I don't know why this was so bad on my skin!

A simple step yet it does so much to the skin. I notice a difference right away. It helps the skin to absorb and receive the great benefits of philosophy serums and moisturizers. This one is the perfect product after cleansing and before applying serums, moisturizers and/or boosters. It

avis.titre: GREAT AHA toner - keeps nasty zits at bay!
avis.texte: I have been using this for more than a year now. I don't want to be out of this because my skin has been tame since I started using this product. Yes there is still the occasional hormonal acne but in general my skin is very manageable even during time of the month where zits - especially the cystic ones - can attack. Mild enough for daily use but efficient enough to do what it promises it will do. A mainstay in my skin care routine. Why I knocked down 1 star? PACKAGING. The pump just doesn't work for me. Even when I press the cotton round right on top of the hole to pump, the product will still find a way to squirt on the sides once in a while. So I have to transfer this to another dispenser that will not spill some of the product when I dispense it. That's the only way I can maximize the content.

This has helped with my stubborn acne scars, texture, pores, lines, you name it! So easy to use, effective and great for my sensitive skin! Difference after first use and now on my 3rd bottle. Must try and would recommended!
I am now ordering my 2nd shipment of this microDelivery Resurfacing treatment. It really works!! I have been a Philosophy girl since 2006. This brand NEVER disappoints.
I love this product! It helps leaves my face smooth and cleansed after each use.

avis.titre: Little bumps all on forehead and cheeks
avis.texte: I love this product at first, but after the 3rd use I noticed my skin felt rough, dry, and is covered in tiny bumps on my forehead and cheeks. I'm in my late 30s so I don't have an issue with acne, but it almost feels like tiny pimples or hives. I will be returning this product as this reaction is worrisome. I love philosophy and have used their products for years. I'm really disappointed that this didn't work out and an hoping this skin irritation clears up quickly.

I've been using this for about 9 months and it's made a tremendous difference in my skin texture. I have very dry skin that seemed to always be flaky no matter what moisturizer I used. This product removes the dry skin allowing my serums and moisturizers to be better absorbed. I no longer have dry, flaky skin and the overall texture and appearance has improved. I could see a difference after only a few days of use.
I use every evening...makes my skin feel clean and refreshed!!! help to maintain wrinkles on my forehead

This is the first product that has truly improved the hyperpigmentation and sun spots on my face. It has also smoothed the appearance of my skin and improved the texture immensely. I get so discouraged with pricey products that have no visible effects on my skin, but this product is worth every penny. I can clearly see a huge improvement in the condition of my skin.

This is my 2nd bottle. Have finished 1st bottle which lasted a few months. I use it religiously by wetting a cotton pad n wipe over my skin right after I showered at night. It is working slowly, gradually but I can see my spots lighter (melasma too), and more radiant skin overall. I hope for continue improvement.
I use this a few times a week after cleansing with clear days ahead wash I have definitely noticed a difference with my skin.

I just began to use this resurfacing tonic and I am thrilled with the results! It keeps my skin well hydrated and felling smooth! It's become part of my nighttime face routine. It makes shaving easier in the morning! I highly recommend this product for men as an evening product after cleaning your face! Use a light moisturizer after! And, don't forget to use a sunscreen during the day!

I am very surprised at this product. It's got a punch. I have VERY sensitive skin where if I touch my skin it breaks out. Acne and dryness are my enemies. Anyhow. I tried it with the exfoliating mousse. It burns like a BAD if you combine those too. I was tearing up like a monsoon. If you use jsut this after you wash your face: it doesn't burn as bad. Dab it with a cotton pad less painful. Smooth over face with cotton pad: stings. I suggest no open wounds. I've used this for 4-5 days and I have REALLY liked it so far. I have sensitive skin so it says less how many times you use it. I decided to commit to it each day. It has done wonders to the dry patches on each side of my chin and my Overall face. The dry patches are less and less. I will continue to use.

I used this a few times. Every time it peeled the skin in patches on my nose. I found it a little scary actually, and stopped using it. I don't have particularly sensitive skin, either. I love philosophy products, but this one was not for me.
I'm 81 and have been a long time Philosophy Woman and wanted to try this microdelivery—used it the first night and surprisingly the next morning my skin was visibly smoother!!!!

It's helps with my flakey skin, pores seem smaller and skin is softer. But, it breaks me out. I've stopped and starting using it several times to make sure it's the culprit and unfortunately, it is. Really like what it does but I can't deal with breakouts. Also, the bottle is a nightmare. It squirts around the cotton ball and lands on your counter. I've tried many ways of dispensing it and nothing works great.
Amazing. I love the way my skin feels after using. It's so smooth and soft.
Leave my skin so soft! I use it after cleansing and have never felt my skin this soft

An SA at Ulta introduced and demoed this product and other on my skin. I worked so well and I saw such much of a difference that I bought it. My texture has vastly improved, my skin is brighter and with my adult acne has gotten better (thought that is due to this being used in conjunction with my other item in my regimen). Since I have other products with either AHA or PHA in them, I don't used this every day. I use this 3 times per week. This is a great chemical exfoliant. I recommend this 100%
I've been using Philosophy for over 20 years. This is a keeper. I'm using this instead of the miracle pads they had for a long time. It seems to do the same thing.
What an amazing product! I can't believe the difference it's made on my skin!

avis.titre: Great product to add to your regimen.
avis.texte: I have been using the product for a while now. Purchased with an "I will try it and see" thought. Absolutely love it. I use it Mon-Fri every night after cleansing with Purity. I should not be surprised, I love all Philosphy products. Really notice the difference if I skip a day or two. Definitely recommend, but the delivery system could use improvement. Kinda of messy as I have seen reported in other reviews. Didn't stop me from giving 5 stars though.
I noticed a difference with my first use. After 2 weeks, my skin tone is much more even, my pores are smaller, and my face is smoother and glowing. This is a must.

I bought this a month ago and absolutely fell in love with the product. The difference it made in my skin was immediate. However, I cannot stand the bottle or the dispenser. The push to disperse can be messy. I try very hard to push evenly and gently, but product still flys out onto my counter. All I can think of each time that happens is the waste of product and money. The lid dies not close tightly which makes it impossible to travel with. I am very very torn if I will purchase again. As I said I love the product but I cannot stand the bottle.
This is my new favorite item! Love the way it has transformed my skin! This is my new daily staple in my regimen!

avis.titre: Clears up dark spots and brightens complexion!
avis.texte: I've been using the resurfacing toner for almost a month now, and the areas on my face where I had discoloration and dark spots is super clear and even now! My mom complimented my makeup the other day thinking I already had foundation on, but I was bare faced! My skin feels smoother, and looks brighter. I love this toner! Please never discontinue this product, Philosophy!

I like this product and my face feels very smooth since I have been using it. Only problem I find is getting it out of the container. I have arthritis in my hands and this product is thick and I cannot squeeze the container hard enough.

avis.titre: Terrific Product But Hate the Packaging
avis.texte: When I can get any product out of the packaging, the solution itself seems to work very well and I imagine that I would gladly purchase again. But I won't unless the packaging is changed. It is so difficult to get out of the bottle that I often times skip this step altogether. There are too many good products out there to add more chaos to my life with this packaging.
I have only been using this for a few weeks and I can already see a difference in my skin tone. My skin is more even toned and smooth.

I just tried this a week ago, and when I tell you that this is Amazing….. omg! It wipes gunk off of my face that didn't know I had! After cleansing at night I put this on a cotton ball, wipe and yuck….. do it again and it's clear. After one night of use I seen a difference the next day. I've been using it every night since. I have: hyperpigmentation, dull, textured on one side, occasional acne, sensitive, easily sunburned skin. Everyday that I have used this I've seen a difference. I am already buying 2 extras! My pores are smaller, texture is starting to smooth, skin tone becoming more even, no new acne breakouts, and more radiant skin. I was nervous about trying this thinking that it would be to harsh for my skin….. but NOPE! I wash my face with philosophy turmeric face wash, apply this, aloe Vera gel, vitamin C booster powder mixed with the philosophy water cream, then I use the overnight miracle worker + line corrector. This routine has my skin glowing on FaceTime&videos, looking radiant, and clear. This is a great addition to my routine, and new skincare staple of mine! I have completely switched my skincare routine to philosophy products, and couldn't be happier with the result. I don't understand what took me so long to try these products, but better late then never!

avis.titre: witch hazel with a few additives
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a few weeks now and it seems to be a good product. I am a little disappointed in the fact that it is mainly witch hazel with some other additives. I can do my own witch hazel. I am 60 and have not achieved the baby soft skin advertised though.
Great exfoliation, smaller pores, smoother skin. A little drying first few uses, but with continued use it works great! I use 4- 5 times aweek
Does exactly what it says it will do. After a week my skin was noticeably glowing!

I liked the results of this on my skin. My skin felt clean and not dry. It was a bit tricky the first time I used it. I used a cotton circular pad, primed it a bit and some product went out one side. No problems after that first try.

I tried the Microdelivery resurfacing solution about 2 weeks ago, have used it 3 times, my skin feels and looks amazing!! I'm 60 yrs. old and I have the normal aging, dark circles under eyes, fine lines and all the other damage, aging can cause. I use this resurfacing lotion in the morning after my bath and prior to appling my makeup for the day. This system works well for me. I highly recommend women of age get this lotion!!

I know it's a resurfacing treatment, but actually really gentle on my normal skin. Not really scented. Used with a cotton pad, right after cleansing at night. I'm not sure I've noticed a huge difference so far, time will tell, but my skin feels smooth and clean afterwards. Packaging is good, though you need a cotton pad or cloth to use.

I have tried the face cleanser from this brand, and it's working so well for me that today I am using the 6th bottle of their cleaner. Thanks to influenster for giving me the chance to try this product. I really love this product. It helps to remove the dirt and helps to reduce oil from my t zone, and helps to minimize the pores
I like the product. I have been using it about 3-4 times a week. I have noticed that my skin is softer and smoother. It is a good value for the money. It's not a cheaper product but worth the price.

I found this resurfacing solution very enjoyable to use. The packaging worked well to distribute product onto a cotton round. There were times when I had gotten may be a little too much sun and it would sting slightly but nothing painful, just a feeling of knowing it's working. I really like that it has cica in it, pairing a light soothing ingredient with exfoliators is a smart move.

I was so excited to test out this resurfacing solution by Philosophy! I feel like my complexion hasn't been the greatest between sunburns, bad tan lines, and mask wearing all day at work. I started out slowly and for the past few weeks have mostly used this every other evening. I didn't find it very drying which was a relief, but I haven't gotten up to 5x per week usage. It has taken off the dead skin without leaving me raw. I'm hoping with further use it will shrink my pores, but I haven't seen a noticeable different there yet.

I really like this product! I use 3-5 times a week as part of my evening skincare routine. It didn't take long to notice that my skin appeared brighter and was softer to the touch. I did not experience any adverse reactions with my skin. I would definitely recommend!

I was absolutely thrilled to try this because, I have extremely sensitive skin that breaks out or reacts easily. It has centella asiatica which is my all time favorite skincare ingredient. It also had 4% ahas, vitamin c, and niacinamide which are all great. This is a very gentle exfoliator that also replenishes. My skin hasn't broken out or been irritated by it but I also don't use it more than a couple times a week. I'm very happy with how soft, smooth, and hydrated it makes my skin. My acne scars are fading and I can see my skin tone starting to even out. The only bad thing I can really say is that I'm not a fan of the pump to get the product out. Other than that it works well with all my other products and I can't wait to see how my skin looks when I'm done with it. Overall, it's a great product.

My skin feels so soft after using this. After 3 weeks I did see a noticeable difference in hydration and the texture of my skin. This did not dry my face out either like most products do. New favorite in my skincare routine.
This works. Gentle but very effective. Highly recommend as a gentle peel. I use everyday no problems.

I've used this for about 4 weeks and have seen some little improvement in my skin tone. It looks a bit brighter in the morning after using it at night. I'd have to use a bit longer to know the long term.

avis.titre: MY PHiLoSoPHY iS To uSe PHiLoSoPHY PeRMeNeNTLY FRo
avis.texte: I received this to try via Philosophy and Influenster. I tried it for two weeks. I love this stuff as it makes my skin feel baby soft! Now, it's been a longgggg time since I was a baby, so for my skin to feel this good was mind-blowing! I mean, it even seems like it has a better glow about it! Seriously, as God is my witness, there are no enhancements done on the two pictures. Although, I took the first picture with my iPhone and the second one with my iPad. That is the only difference. The other difference you are seeing is 100% the results of the product!! I really love that it allowed the lines in my forehead and the dark circles under my eyes to diminish as those two things have been serious problems for me, particularly as I age! In the second picture, I noticed there is a bit of reddening around my nose area. It didn't burn or anything, so I guess it may be from where I was rubbing, maybe a little too hard as my nose area is super sensitive. I also loved that my pores are smaller, and the skin looks a lot more ALIVE!!! I really like Philosophy skincare. I have made the decision to implement it into my skincare routine permanently. My philosophy is that I will continue to use Philosophy from here on out because Lord knows I need ALL the help I can get! Thank you again, Philosophy and Influenster!!

love this solution! it really helped the appearance of my pores and I do plan on purchasing again! as with any other product you have to make sure to use it consistently for at least 2 weeks to notice results, nothing is instant and if that's what you're looking for this isn't it. be patient and I think you'll love it too! Definitely recommend!

As someone with rosacea that has been exacerbated by masks, I was a little hesitant to dive in full force with this product. However, used in conjunction with my Rx rosacea products it's been a good combo. I avoid the sensitive areas on my nose and chin and stick to cheeks and forehead. It's not an overnight change, but you can notice a difference.
It is doing exactly what it is suppose to do. My face feels so much better.

I'm typically a huge fan of Philosophy products as they are usually are kind to my sometimes sensitive skin. First off, I like this bottle. It's unique in that it's curve to keep the product from spilling out and you have to push it in yo get product out which helps control you from getting too much in your cotton pad. You use this like a toner. The package recommends 5 times a week. Unfortunately, my already summer dry skin freaked after 2 days and my face became much dryer with visibly dry patches and tightness. I had to call in some serious moisturizer and take a few days off from this product. It doesn't have an overwhelming scent and I'm betting if my skin wasn't already dry this would be far more effective. I'll give it another go once my skin is more hydrated.

So to be fair, I'm a Philosophy fan. I love the products and the company. I expected to be happy with the product and as usual, Philosophy delivered. It was a gentle peel that cleared up some problem areas and overall improved the time, texture and evenness of my complexion. I'm not crazy about the applicator top but the product itself is great for a maintenance peel.

I received this product for free from Influencer in exchange for an honest review but I was really excited to receive it because I have used a lot of philosophy's different acid peels and have been very pleased with them. However this product makes my face feel raw and has caused small blisters. I think it may be too strong which is weird because I have never had problems with philosophy products before. I love the concept, once a day under normal night routine but I think it needs a little more work.

I have to be extremely careful with what I put on my skin due to its sensitivity. I've been using this religiously for a few weeks and it does not break me out nor dry out my skin. I do see a bit of improvement in my skin tone (specifically along my cheekbones).Microdelivery Resurfacing Solution

I received this free to try. It seems like it does a good job. My skin feels smoother and seems like makeup goes on better. I use this at night (5x/wk) after cleansing but before moisturizer. Wish I would have taken a before/after selfie!

This is really an awesome product! It's very gentle yet very effective. This product does exactly what it claims to do. It exfoliates my skin without leaving it feeling dry. It may be a little pricey but definitely worth the splurge. The only thing I didn't care for is the dispenser.
I love this product ! Makes my skin feel clean and makes my pores feel smaller/tighter. I really like the difference I feel in my skin! I would recommend this to a friend !

This resurfacing solution is really nice! It claims to be a liquid exfoliator that instantly replenishes and resurfaces skin. It also claims to boost hydration while also minimizing the appearance of pores and uneven skin tone. My personal experience with the product is that it really improved my skin tone and provided hydration! My skin is usually quite red, especially once I've washed my face at night. Per the instructions, I washed my face as usual and then swept the solution over my face using a cotton round. I allowed the solution to dry as I brushed my teeth, then continued with my serums and moisturizer. I noticed a significant reduction in the redness of my skin. My pores… not so much. I have rather large pores on my cheeks and nose and I don't think anything is going to reduce those bad boys. I did notice a sort of sticky finish once the solution dried, but I applied serums and moisturizer so that didn't really matter to me. It is a very nice product! I will continue to use it in my skincare routine.

I have only been using this product a few days & already see a decrease in the blackheads around my nose! I am also noticing a smoother surface texture. One thing I'm not a fan of is the medicinal smell. It is subtle but noticeable to me.
I love that you can use this up to 5 times a week! It's made my skin so soft and smooth. No smell, easy to use. Will buy again! Got this for free in a VoxBox.

avis.titre: if you're used to acids, nothing special
avis.texte: Okay for sensitive skin, felt some tingly but nothing bad. It's not the best on the market but if you've never used acids before this would be a great place to start. Didn't cause any irritation or inflammation, but also don't think i saw drastic changes and I didn't LOVE it how I love other things

What. In. The. Actual. HECK!? This stuff is magic in a bottle. I have absolutely NEVER had a product do so much and make such a difference for my skin IN MY LIFE!! I started out using this nightly. It eventually slightly irritated my skin so I backed off and started skipping a day here and there. I've never so confidently not worn make up. I couldn't be happier and I will most definitely be purchasing this again. I would highly recommend. I typically have fairly sensitive skin. This has made my pores smaller, cleared my skin up, and reduced my 11's tremendously. Thank you so much for the opportunity to test this product. It's fantastic!

I've been using this rather exclusively for exfoliating since receiving it, I did use Philosophy's micro scrub a time or two. For the duration the texture of my skin remained smooth. It was much more gentle than other acids (glycolic or lactic) I've used in a toner form. I did have a few blemishes pop up which isn't normal, this could have been from switching products, mask wearing, etc. but continuing to use this toner, they cleared up quickly. I'm not positive how best to incorporate it into my skincare routine with a retinol product. I would highly suggest this for someone newer to chemical exfoliates or looking for a very gentle product.
I have very sensitive skin and I am concerned about a reaction I had with the first use.

I've only been using this product for 2 weeks and have not given it enoughtime for an honest opinion. Upon opening the box though, I noticed how nice and functional the packaging was! The top is a flip top and product is dispensed by pushing down on the pump. So easy and minimal product waste is a win-win! In another 2 weeks I will review the actual benefits I've experienced. ***UPDATE*** I've been using this product for almost a month. I honestly haven't seen a huge difference. There's been a slight minimizing to my pores but other than that, no noticeable difference. I wanted to love this product but for the price, it's not something I'd repurchase.

I love this product! The application is clean and easy, the product doesn't have a smell, is very gentle for the skin and the results (smaller pores and brighter skin) were visible after just few uses. Very happy I was able to test it and I will repurchase!

I really enjoyed this because I have always had trouble with textured skin. This product made my skin smooth and glowey. I wasn't to happy with how you get the product out but I still give it 5 stars.

I was so excited to get the opportunity to try this product. For years I have suffered from dry flaky skin, large pores, adult acne, and an uneven skin tone ~ not to mention the fine lines that have begun to appear. I have tried numerous products only to find that a product might help one of these issues, but then worsen another (ex. A product might help reduce my acne, but worsen dryness). Philosophy's Microdelivery Resurfacing Solution has helped all of these problems without increasing or causing others. The solution goes on easily (similar to applying a toner) and dries quickly. Just be sure to place the cotton ball or pad down so that it completely covers the pump or the product might squirt out. I have been using this product for approximately three weeks and have seen noticeable improvements ~ pores have minimized, acne occurs less frequently, skin tone is more balanced and dry flakes have been eliminated. The improvements did not happen overnight, but have happened gradually over these past weeks. I have also found for me it is best to use the solution daily rather than the recommended five times weekly. If I skip days my skin begins to become flaky. This is a product that I will continuing to use and would highly recommend.

I really enjoyed this product, I used 5 nights a week over the last four weeks and my skin has never been so smooth. I found myself using it instead of my traditional night time toner. I would recommend using it on it's own or with other Philosophy products, I have tried it both ways. I plan on keeping this part of my routine.

So the philosophy "solution" is nothing mind-blowing and you can definitely find similar products at a lower price point. It's a great exfoliant if you want to throw something on in the morning because it doesn't leave your face tacky and my other products layered well on top (just make sure you wear sunscreen). I didn't see a visible change but my face did feel mildly smoother after use. The packaging is really nice, there's a built in pump for cotton rounds if you're into those (I'm not, I just pump directly into my hand). As long as you're looking for a light exfoliant at a higher price- I think you'd be really pleased.

I received my voxbox for microdelivery resurfacing solution. It did not meet my expectations. The scent smelled like the soap in hospital bathrooms. And when I applied it... well it was definitely more than a tingle, but less than burning. Using my usual moisturizer did help with the smell and take away some of the tingle/burn, but it still didn't feel good. While I appreciate the opportunity to get to try this, I would not recommend it for anyone with sensitive skin.

I had considered going out and getting a microdermabrasion face treatment, but the cost stopped me. When I received the opportunity to try this product, I was super excited. You just put a little bit of it on a facial cloth and wipe it over your face up to 5 times a week. My skin just feels super smooth after using it and and feels like it's taking off the dead skin. It does not turn my face red, it does not cause any pain at all. Zero negatives for me. Highly recommended it, and I will definitely be buying it again.

avis.titre: Easy to use and helped my Skin
avis.texte: When this product arrived I loved seeing how easy it was to use, it has a press down to get the product out. I have get a lot of sun spots in the summer so I am always looking for products to use to help even my skin tone and this product was able to help with that. This product did not offer as much moisture to my face as I thought but still provided some. I would recommend this product

This is a great product! The dispenser makes it easy to saturate a cotton pad with the perfect amount. After using it for a few weeks 3-4x/week, my skin has less texture and my skin tone is more even. I did not find this product harsh on my skin.

I feel that Philosophy microdelivery resurfacing solution works really well. After just one week of use my skin was smoother, the appearance of lines was reduced and my face feels softer and a lot less dry. I didn't have any sort of skin irritation with it either. I would definitely recommend this product and would purchase it in the future.

I expected to see results of using this after a few weeks and ended up seeing results after the first use. I immediately noticed that my skin was glowing after use. I use it a few times a week and never use it with retinol or tretinoin because it's too much acidic stuff on my face. I've actually found that I prefer to use it in the morning because I like putting vitamin C on my face every morning. I have very fair, sensitive skin and had no problem with using this. I'm also used to other acidic skincare products, so that may be why it doesn't bother my skin.

Never used a philosophy product before so I can't speak on the brands quality as a whole but I really like this one. It's left my skin more even toned and also helped with firmness and breakouts. I've been using it since I got it 4-5 times a week. Will continue to use it!
The Microdelivery is a resurfacing solution, and feels like applying a toner. It was gentle and soothing, I'm currently experiencing small fine lines on my forehead so I'm excited to see my results.
This does everything it says it does and more. My skin feels and looks amazing ! No harsh smell or chemical feeling at all

You have glycolic and lactic acid as the AHAs in this to help exfoliate your skin, while it also contains hydrating and soothing ingredients to help nourish your skin. This also uses a Vitamin C derivative called -O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, which is a promising ingredient that helps brighten skin, is an antioxidant and has anti-inflammatory properties. Using this product, I noticed that it does not feel tacky, and my skin soaked it up quickly.
